hint_ladder.title: Orient
hint_ladder.text: Isipin mo ang isang guro na may dalang mga binhi. Itatago ba niya, ipunin, o ikakalat? The core meaning is scattering.

hint_ladder.title: Rule
hint_ladder.text: 'Disseminate' mula sa Latin na 'seminare'—maghasik ng binhi. Kaya it's about spreading seeds of info. The synonym must mean to scatter widely.

hint_ladder.title: Apply
hint_ladder.text: Tingnan ang choices. 'Conceal' at 'Withhold' ay pagtatago, 'Collect' ay pag-iipon. Only one means spreading.

hint_ladder.title: Nearly There
hint_ladder.text: Isipin ang barangay captain na nag-a-announce ng bagong curfew. Ipo-post niya sa lahat ng pader, ipaaalam sa bawat bahay—that's disseminating. So '...

A.text: You might have chosen A because 'dis-' made you think of removal, but 'disseminate' means to spread, not hide.

B.text: You might have chosen B because 'withhold' sounds like holding back, but disseminate is releasing, not withholding.

C.text: Correct. 'Disseminate' means to spread widely, like scattering seeds of information.

D.text: You might have chosen D because 'collect' is about gathering, but disseminate is the opposite—scattering.

Ngayon, tandaan mo: 'Disseminate' parang 'disseminate seeds'—spread. Pag may tanong sa exam, isipin ang magsasaka na naghahasik. Ang synonyms na 'conceal', 'withhold', 'collect' ay opposite—parang kinikimkim ang buto, hindi kinakalat. Only 'Spread' ang tama.
next_time_rule: The 'Seed-Scatter' Test: See 'disseminate,' picture farmer sowing seeds. Avoid words meaning hide, hold, gather. Pick 'spread' or 'distribute'.
